title: ILDA technical standards
why: The primary list of the Standard Projector, test pattern, IDTF and IDN documents with revision dates.

title: LaserFX: How Laser Shows Work - Graphics System
why: A plain-language explanation of points, frames and why lasers draw vectors. Old (1996-2008) but foundational.

title: Pangolin Wiki: BEYOND manual, Vectors and Points
why: Working documentation on points, anchors, blanking and flicker. A vendor manual, so it shows how one product does it.

title: Glenn Thomas: The Laserium Laserist
why: The most detailed first-hand account of what an analog laserist did each night.

title: Event Safety Alliance: Laser Show Safety in Practice
why: A laser safety officer's account of setup, alignment and zoning on a show day.

title: ILDA Awards 2026 rules
why: Category definitions that double as a map of the kinds of laser show that exist.

title: ILDA: Laser Light Show Safety Overview
why: One page on what the operator is expected to do before and during a show.
